device.basis: Memory port block at 0xff143000 of X-T20 2.11 stage 2: the resident start writes 0xf to +0x104 of the blocks at 0xff142000, 0xff143000, 0xff147000 and 0xff148000 (store helper 0x8338 at 0x8340) before its flash set-up. +0x104 is the memory port access mask word that FujiMod's X-Processor Pro boot controller models for the ROM's own writes (memory_port_bases); a resident start runs without that controller. The words read back their last write; no arbitration is modeled.
